items.title: Tag both repos `legacy-v0` (backend `3a143f2`, frontend `fc6ffd9`) and note in README that legacy code is reference only.
Commit the staged untracking of `wwwroot/uploads` and the `.gitignore` change.

Move legacy backend code out of the build: `legacy/` folder (excluded from the solution) containing old controllers/services for reference during module reviews. The API is left with only real endpoints (health); all 501 stubs and mock providers are removed from the running app.
Remove `phronesis.db`, dev HTML landing page and markdown spec route from `Program.cs`.
Create the structure in [target architecture §9](target-architecture.md#9-documentation-structure-target): `product/`, `specs/`, `plan/`, `adr/`, `audit/`, `runbooks/`, `archive/`.
Move and rename: `problem-definition-and-discovery.md` → `product/`, `system-modules.md` → `product/`, DB and API specs → `specs/`; give extension-less files `.md` extensions; fix misspelt names.
Move walkthrough reports (identity, staff, teacher, M11–M14, media, search) and superseded plans to `archive/` with a header "superseded by the implementation plan of 2026-11-20".
Delete empty `problemstatement.md`.
Write `docs/README.md`: index + "source of truth" table.
Write ADRs 0001–0008 from decisions D-001, D-007, D-011, D-012, D-013 and the token design.
`docs/README.md` linking to this plan; keep only frontend-specific docs.
Replace the three old brand documents with `docs/design-system/brand-and-design-system.md`; move old ones to `docs/archive/`.
Move `learner_portal_implementation_plan.md` and old plans to `docs/archive/`.
Rename `public/new-logos-phronesis/` → `public/brand/source/` (raw files) and retire the old blue/teal brand PDFs to the archive.

Move all legacy pages and their components out of `src/app` into `legacy/` (outside the build, kept for reference during each module's rebuild). The routed app starts clean, with no mock-data screens, so `next build` passes without patching broken legacy code.
Remove dev routes (`/brand-audit`, `/identity`) and the dead `lib/api.ts`.
Upgrade vulnerable dependencies (`next`, `sharp`, `zod`, transitive) and re-run `npm audit`.
Walk through open decisions O-01…O-14 with Phronesis; record outcomes or confirm defaults; set gates.
Request vector logo files (O-12).
`Phronesis.slnx` lists all projects; `Directory.Build.props` (nullable, warnings as errors, analyzers, deterministic builds); `Directory.Packages.props` (central versions).
Layer and module folder structure per target architecture §4.1; `.editorconfig`.
Building blocks: `Entity`, `AggregateRoot`, `ValueObject`, `DomainEvent`, `Result`/error model, `Money`, `IClock`, `ICurrentUser`.
Command/query handler abstractions + decorators (validation, transaction, audit, logging) registered with Scrutor.
Error handling: ProblemDetails with stable codes; global exception handler; consistent success envelope helpers.
API versioning (`/api/v1`), OpenAPI + Scalar, OpenAPI JSON exported in CI to `docs/api/openapi.v1.json`.

Authorization foundation: fallback policy = authenticated + explicit policy required; permission policy provider (no undefined-policy fallthrough); architecture test "every endpoint declares a policy".
PostgreSQL 17 with Npgsql; snake-case naming; schema-per-module configuration; UUID v7 key generation.
Interceptors: timestamps, audit trail, outbox capture of domain events.
New migration baseline (legacy SQL Server migrations archived); migrations run as a separate deploy step, never at app start in production.
Environment-aware seeding framework (reference data everywhere; demo data local/staging only; no passwords in code: first Super Admin created by a one-time CLI command).
Hangfire on PostgreSQL + outbox dispatcher job; dashboard behind `admin.jobs` permission.
`IFileStorage` (private disk) with validation pipeline (allow-lists, magic bytes, size, server-generated keys).
Email abstraction with templating (Razor or MJML-based) + Mailpit in development.
Serilog JSON logging with PII/secret redaction (no request bodies); correlation IDs across API and web.
OpenTelemetry traces/metrics exporter (configurable endpoint); Sentry-compatible error tracking.
Health checks: live/ready (PostgreSQL, storage, Hangfire).
Rate limiting policies; security headers; strict CORS from configuration.
Options validation at startup (fail fast on missing secrets); `.env.example` complete.
Test projects per target architecture; Testcontainers PostgreSQL fixture; Respawn reset; test data builders.
Architecture tests: layer rules, module boundaries, no `DbContext` in Api, endpoint-policy rule.
Authorization matrix test harness (role × endpoint → expected status) ready for every later phase.

Release-hygiene guards in CI (both repos): fail on placeholder copy ("coming soon", "lorem ipsum", "TBD", "under construction"), mock/fixture imports outside test folders, endpoints returning 501, mock providers registered outside Development/Test, dev-only routes in production builds, `console.log` and `alert()` in shipped code.
Server-side feature flags for module release (routes 404 and navigation hidden while off), managed by Super Admin, audited; frontend navigation built only from enabled modules.

`deploy/docker-compose.dev.yml` (PostgreSQL, Mailpit), `.staging.yml`, `.prod.yml`, Caddyfile, Postgres tuning for KVM 2, resource limits per [memory budget](target-architecture.md#31-memory-budget-production--small-staging-on-the-same-vps).
Dockerfiles: API (chiselled/non-root), web (Next standalone, non-root).

GitHub Actions: backend and frontend CI on pushes to `dev`, `test` and `main`; image build → GHCR; deploy to staging on push to `test`; deploy to production on push to `main` (tagged) with manual approval; branch protection on all three.
Provision the Hostinger KVM 2: hardening (SSH keys, ufw, fail2ban, unattended upgrades), Docker, DNS (O-10), Caddy TLS, staging basic-auth.
Backups: nightly DB + files to off-box encrypted storage; restore script; first restore drill.
External uptime monitoring; alert channel.
Runbooks: local setup, deploy, rollback, backup/restore, secrets rotation.
New folder structure (target architecture §5.1); `middleware.ts` → `proxy.ts`; strict TypeScript; ESLint zero-error baseline; Prettier; Husky + lint-staged.
Generated API client pipeline (OpenAPI → typed client + TanStack Query hooks); query client defaults; error normalisation from ProblemDetails.
Session handling: in-memory access token, refresh via cookie, `/auth/me`, permission helpers, surface guards (wired fully in Phase 2).
Brand tokens (colour, type, spacing, radius, elevation, motion) as CSS variables + Tailwind v4 theme; self-hosted fonts via `next/font`.

Core components: Button, IconButton, Link, Input, Textarea, Select, Combobox, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, DatePicker, FileUpload, Form field, Dialog, Drawer, Dropdown, Tabs, Table (sortable, paginated), Card, Badge/Status pill, Avatar, Toast, Alert, Skeleton, EmptyState, ErrorState, Pagination, Breadcrumbs, Stepper, ProgressBar, Tooltip.
Layout shells: Public header/footer, Portal shell (learner/family/teach), Staff Console shell (permission-driven nav), Account shell.
Component catalogue in Storybook (separate from the app, never deployed with it) with accessibility checks.
Vitest + Testing Library, Playwright setup with a smoke test, axe checks.
Users, credentials, email verification (hashed single-use tokens), login with lockout and rate limits, logout.
Sessions: rotating hashed refresh tokens, reuse detection, device list, revoke one/all; revoke all on password reset/suspension.
Password reset and change; password policy; breached-password check.
MFA (TOTP + recovery codes), mandatory for staff roles.
Roles and permissions seeded from code (role model in decisions §9); permission matrix document generated from code; role assignment with separation-of-duties rules; changes audited.
Staff: departments, staff profiles, invitation flow (email link to set password + MFA — no temporary passwords in responses), suspend/reactivate.
Account status (pending/active/suspended/deactivated) separate from profile statuses.
Agreements framework: versioned legal documents and acceptance records (terms, privacy; teacher agreement later).
Security events log (login success/failure, MFA changes, role changes) and audit for all admin actions.
Transactional emails: verify email, reset password, staff invitation, security alerts.
Single `/login` with role-based landing; register (learner/guardian entry points), verify email, forgot/reset password, MFA setup and challenge.
`/account`: profile, password, MFA, sessions, agreements.
Staff Console: Users (search, filter, status actions), Roles & permissions (view; edit for Super Admin), Staff & invitations, Security events.
Surface guards and 403/404 pages.

Learner profile (admission number, date of birth, curriculum, current grade, county, status); one canonical learner ID used everywhere (fixes H-02). County is also captured for guardians, teachers and store buyers to support national operations reporting (P10.7).
Guardian profile; guardian–learner links with relationship, primary payer flag, consent record and visibility permissions; link invitations in both directions with expiry.
Minor rules per O-02 (consent gate on purchases and live classes).
Teacher profile (bio, qualifications, experience, competences per grade/subject, status: Applicant → Verified → Onboarding → Active → Suspended/Revoked).
Teacher application state machine: Draft → Submitted → Under review → (Interview scheduled) → Changes requested → Approved / Rejected; resubmission rules; history.
Documents: typed (ID, certificates, TSC registration, etc.), validated uploads to private storage, per-document verification status, reviewer-only access with logged views.
Reviewer workflow: queue, assignment, completeness checklist, notes, interview scheduling with manual Meet link, decision with reason, notifications to applicant.
Teacher agreement acceptance (conduct, safeguarding, content licence); onboarding fee step modelled as a pending requirement (activated in Phase 7).
Suspension/revocation with reason, audit, and effect on permissions.
Learner onboarding (grade, subjects); guardian onboarding and linking flows; consent screens.
Teacher Arena: application wizard (profile → competences → documents → review & submit), status tracker, change requests.
Staff Console → Academic review: applications queue, application detail with document viewer, checklist, interview, decision.
Family portal shell: linked learners list and link management.

Curriculum and curriculum versions; education levels; grades; subjects; grade–subject mapping; strands; sub-strands (topics); learning objectives; ordering; prerequisites. Nothing hard-coded (data-driven per `initial.md` §10).
Spreadsheet import (validate → preview diff → apply) and export; audit of taxonomy changes; archive instead of delete.
Teacher competence mapping uses the taxonomy (migrate Phase 3 free-text if any).
Cached public read endpoints (grades → subjects → topics).
Frontend: Staff Console → Curriculum manager (tree editor, reorder, import wizard); public/learner subject browser components.
Import the approved CBC taxonomy for the launch grades.

Resource aggregate with versions; resource types (notes, past papers, topical questions, exercises, exams, marking schemes, videos, animations, class materials, teacher resources); multi-classification (grades, subjects, topics, objectives); tags; licensing and ownership metadata.

Lifecycle: Draft → Submitted → Under review → Changes requested → Approved → Scheduled → Published → Archived; Rejected. Author ≠ reviewer; checklist; threaded comments; publish scheduling; new version of a published resource goes through review while the old version stays live.
Access rules per resource: free, premium (entitlement key), staff-only; preview segments.

Media: upload sessions, validation, private storage, processing status; signed short-lived access endpoints streaming files; PDF viewing with per-user watermark; download policy; access logging; video via external host with signed playback (O-07).
Discovery: PostgreSQL full-text search with weights, trigram fuzzy matching, filters (grade, subject, topic, type, free/premium), sorting, facets; featured, recent and popular lists.
Events: `ResourcePublished` → notifications/projections via outbox.

Exam-paper metadata on resources: exam type (past paper, mock, end-of-term, opener, county/zonal, Phronesis original), year, term, paper number, duration, total marks, grade(s), subject, and a linked marking scheme resource (kept as a separate, restricted resource). Rights record per paper (owner, licence, evidence; O-18). Prepares the Phase 7 store.
Content studio (Staff Console → Content, and Teacher Arena → My contributions): create, classify, upload, preview, submit, respond to review.
Review queue and review screen (side-by-side preview, checklist, comments, decision).
Learner library: subject → topic pages, resource cards, search with filters, resource viewer (PDF viewer with watermark, video player, worksheet download), premium lock states with upgrade prompt.
Learner workspace: dashboard (continue learning, upcoming classes, assigned work, recent activity), my subjects, bookmarks, recently viewed, learning history.
Activity tracking (resource opened/completed, time on task — privacy-aware) and topic progress.
Question bank: questions with types (multiple choice, multiple select, true/false, short answer, long answer, matching, ordering), options, marking schemes, difficulty, taxonomy tags; versioned.
Assessments: topical exercises, timed tests, mock exams; assembly from the bank; publishing via the content review workflow; availability windows and attempt limits.

Attempts: server-side timer enforcement, autosave, submission, automatic marking for objective types, manual grading queue for subjective answers, results with feedback and answer review (when policy allows).
Progress analytics: per subject/topic mastery, assessment performance, timeline; role-controlled visibility (learner, linked guardian, assigned teacher, staff).
Frontend: learner dashboard, assessment player (mobile-first, resilient to connection drops), results; Teacher Arena grading inbox and grading screen; Family portal progress views.

phases.title: Plans, entitlements, manual payments & exam papers store

items.title: Plans as data (audience, ISO-8601 duration, price in KES, entitlement set); plan management in Staff Console; plan comparison page data.
Entitlement engine: grant, consume (credits), expire, revoke; `HasEntitlement` checks used by content (P5.3) and booking (P8).
Orders and invoices with references (`PHX-…`); invoice PDF; expiry of unpaid invoices.
Payment submissions (code, amount, phone, time, optional proof) with idempotency and global uniqueness of M-PESA codes; finance notification on every submission.
Finance queue: confirm / reject / partial, separation of duties, SLA reminders; confirmation activates subscription and entitlements in one transaction; receipts.
Subscriptions: activation, expiry job, renewal reminders, cancellation, suspension.
Teacher onboarding fee and licence through the same flow; activates Teacher status `Active` (completes Phase 3's pending step).
Refunds (recorded, audited, entitlement effects) and reconciliation report against Paybill statements; exports (CSV).
`IPaymentProvider` abstraction with `ManualPaybillProvider`; contract tests ready for Daraja later.

Frontend: pricing/plan selection, checkout with Paybill instructions, payment confirmation form, payment status and history, receipts; guardian paying for linked learners; Staff Console → Finance (queue, payment detail, invoices, refunds, reconciliation, reports).

Store catalogue: store products over exam-paper resources (single paper, subject bundle, grade/term bundle, "full set" bundle); price in KES per product (O-15); publish/unpublish; featured and new; product pages with a free preview (cover page and instructions only, watermarked).
Store search and filters: grade, subject, exam type, year, term; sort by newest/popular; SEO-friendly public pages (server-rendered, structured data).

Buyers: learners, guardians, teachers and members of the public. Checkout requires a verified buyer account (lightweight: name, email, phone, county), per O-17. Cart with several papers and bundles; one invoice per order.
Payment through the Part A manual Paybill flow. On confirmation, an item-level entitlement (`store.paper:{id}`) is granted to the buyer and receipt sent.

Fulfilment: "My purchases" library; download generates a personalised, watermarked PDF on the server (buyer name, email/phone, order number, date on every page) from the private master; download limit and expiring links per policy; in-browser viewing; every download logged.

Marking-scheme requests: request from a purchased paper (or bundle); policy engine per O-16 (included / priced / approval required / release date / role-based, e.g. verified teachers and guardians); staff review queue (Academic Reviewer or Content Manager) with approve/decline and reason; payment step when priced; fulfilment as watermarked PDF; requester notified at each step; full audit.

Store operations: Staff Console → Store (products, bundles, pricing, featured, sales, downloads, marking-scheme queue); refunds for store orders through Part A refunds; abuse controls (download anomalies, shared-link detection, rate limits).

Institutional buyers (schools, tuition centres, homeschool groups): organisation account, bulk order with quantity-based licence and invoice, multiple named downloaders. Ships if O-15 confirms institutional pricing; otherwise moved to Phase 12.
Store reports: sales by paper, subject, grade, county and period; conversion from preview to purchase; marking-scheme request volumes and turnaround.
Frontend: public store (`/exams`, product pages, cart, checkout), buyer library (`/account/purchases`), marking-scheme request flow and status; Staff Console store and request queue.
Class offerings (1:1 and group), capacity, duration, subject/topic, teacher assignment, materials (linked resources), status.
Teacher availability: weekly rules, exceptions, blocked periods, Africa/Nairobi time handling; conflict detection.

Booking state machine (Requested → Confirmed → Scheduled → Completed / Cancelled / No-show) with entitlement or credit check at confirmation, transactional capacity control (row lock / constraint) so the last seat can't be double-booked, and conflict checks against availability and pending bookings.
Rescheduling and cancellation rules (O-05) with credit effects.
Sessions: manual Meet link entry and validation; link visible only to entitled participants; reminders (24 h, 2 h, 15 min) and "link missing" reminders.
Join through the platform (join events), attendance marking by teacher, session notes, learner feedback/ratings (if approved), no-show handling, incident flag to safeguarding.
Teacher earnings ledger entries per completed session (payouts manual per O-03).

Frontend: class discovery and booking (learner/guardian), my schedule (calendar + list), session page with join button; Teacher Arena availability editor, class management, attendance and notes; Staff Console → Classes (schedule, assignments, interventions).
Notification centre: in-app inbox, email channel, templates per event, user preferences, digest options; SMS channel interface (disabled until provider chosen).
Announcements: targeted by role, grade, class; scheduled; read tracking.
Support desk: tickets with categories, priority, SLA, assignment, internal notes, escalation, attachments (validated), satisfaction rating; contextual "Get help" from any screen.
Teacher collaboration: contribution workspace on shared drafts, comments, attribution and contribution history; class-scoped Q&A visible to staff (no free-form learner DMs at launch).
Frontend: notification bell and centre, preferences; Support (all users) and Staff Console → Support queue; collaboration views in Teacher Arena.
Administration: system settings (typed, validated, audited), feature flags, maintenance mode, organisation profile, notification templates editor.

Reporting: management dashboard (learners, teachers, content, subscriptions, revenue, exam paper sales, classes, attendance, assessments), report pages with filters and CSV export, export jobs for large reports; read models where queries are heavy.

National operations view: learners, guardians, teachers, buyers, sales and class activity by county (from profile county), teacher coverage per subject and county, service-level indicators (payment confirmation time, review turnaround, support response) so Phronesis can run and grow operations across Kenya.
Audit explorer: search by actor, entity, action, date; entity history views (teacher, resource, payment); retention policy job.
Data-subject rights (Kenya Data Protection Act): access/export and deletion requests workflow with approval, anonymisation strategy that preserves financial/audit records.

Safeguarding: "Report a concern" on learner/teacher surfaces, concern triage by Safeguarding Lead, user restrictions and blocks, content takedown, incident records, escalation rules; security incident workflow runbook.
Frontend: Staff Console dashboard and reports, audit explorer, safeguarding workspace, settings.

Home, About (mission, values, Christ-centred education), How it works (learners, guardians, teachers), Subjects & grades (from taxonomy, with resource previews), Exam papers store entry points, Pricing (from plans), Live classes, Apply to teach, FAQ, Contact, Legal (terms, privacy, refund, safeguarding, exam-paper licence terms, cookie notice).
SEO: metadata, Open Graph images in the new brand, sitemap, robots, structured data (EducationalOrganization).
Performance budgets met on simulated 4G.
Security review against OWASP ASVS L2 checklist; OWASP ZAP baseline scan; fix all high/medium findings.
Load test (k6) at 3× expected launch traffic on staging-sized resources; tune PostgreSQL and caching.
Accessibility audit (WCAG 2.2 AA) of the five core journeys.
Backup restore drill from production-like data; disaster recovery runbook with RPO 24 h / RTO 4 h.
Alert routing tested end to end.
Production data: Super Admin and staff accounts via invitation; plans, taxonomy, initial content loaded and reviewed.
User acceptance testing with Phronesis staff, a few teachers, guardians and learners; sign-off per journey.
Staff training: finance confirmations, reviews, support, safeguarding (short guides in `docs/runbooks/`).
Release `v1.0.0`; go-live checklist; two weeks of hypercare with daily checks of errors, payment queue and support tickets.
